scope: Two illustrative mathematical stiffness candidates under one already published exact Claim context; not measured fish biology, collective benefit or biological validation.
input_binding: Before each numerical run fetch exact Claim via official MCP, verify Record digest/ref, parse EI_crit rational from statement, verify original result/request scope, multiply parsed value by case margin to construct actual solver EI. No hardcoded fallback stiffness.

cases.question: Does this lower-stiffness candidate violate the declared small-deformation domain?
Does this stiffer candidate remain inside the declared small-deformation domain?

unchanged_context: Exact historical producer request, declared load/span/thresholds unchanged; only EI selected relative to consumed Claim. All source limitations retained.
controls: Wrong uniform-law L^3 mutant rejected by quadrature control
Missing/altered Claim ref or source context fails before solve
Mutating parsed critical value changes derived candidate EI; full scope gate rejects inconsistency
outcomes: Preserve lower invalid candidate and all checks. Model-domain validity is not biological success. No threshold relaxation. Failed computations remain failed.
workflow: Two public Action proposals pin identical typed Claim input BEFORE compute; coordinator readies; individual contributor leases/runs/submits Evidence and Action status via official MCP. Independent operator reviews separately. Worker never accepts work.

roles.worker: contributor in delphi-frontier; public node-a reads

artifact_policy: Exact input/code/environment/output hashes; simulation/plot provenance separated. Never store credentials or lease IDs. Unknown licenses null, reference-only artifacts until separate publication check.
reuse_measurement: Derive count from two distinct live Action versions with recorded typed uses edges pinning same exact Claim, plus causal before-compute Claim-read/input-binding receipts. No time/cost or agency-superiority claim.
